svg.title: GameTheca glyph
svg.desc:
Silhouette of the GameTheca mark — the case frame and the shelf of game cases, solid on transparent, with no plate behind it.
This exists so the mark can be *themed*. gametheca_mark.svg bakes the default green (#12a4a0 -> #4ef2a1) and a #0b0d10 plate into the file, and an external SVG loaded through cannot see the page's custom properties, so on any preset other than the default the brand stayed green while everything around it changed. A monochrome silhouette can be used as a CSS mask-image and painted with var(--gt-accent), which reaches an arbitrary theme colour exactly — where filter: hue-rotate() only approximates one and collapses on the near-greyscale presets.
Keep the geometry in step with gametheca_mark.svg: same viewBox, same coordinates. Only the fills differ, and only because a mask reads alpha.
